title.en: US lifts Fable 5 and Mythos 5 export restrictions; Fable first-party access resumes July 1
title.zhHans: 美国解除 Fable 5 与 Mythos 5 出口限制；Fable 第一方访问于 7 月 1 日恢复

searchSummary.en: Restrictions on Anthropic’s two models were lifted June 30, 2026. The July 1 update confirms Fable 5 first-party access; Mythos 5 remained limited to a set of approved US organizations.
searchSummary.zhHans: 针对 Anthropic 两款模型的限制于 2026 年 6 月 30 日解除。7 月 1 日更新确认 Fable 5 第一方访问恢复；Mythos 5 仍限于一组获批的美国机构。

summary.en: On June 30, 2026, Anthropic announced that US export controls on Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 had been lifted, 18 days after the June 12 directive. Its July 1 update confirmed the return of Fable 5 access on first-party services and said Mythos 5 access had been restored for a set of US organizations following earlier approval. For specified Fable plans, up to 50% of weekly usage limits applied through July 7. Anthropic said it would re-enable third-party cloud access as quickly as possible; that notice did not confirm completion.
summary.zhHans: 2026 年 6 月 30 日，Anthropic 宣布美国解除针对 Claude Fable 5 与 Mythos 5 的出口管制，距 6 月 12 日的指令为 18 天。公司于 7 月 1 日更新确认 Fable 5 在第一方服务恢复访问，并称在此前获批后，Mythos 5 已向一组美国机构恢复访问。对于指定的 Fable 套餐，至 7 月 7 日最多占每周使用限额的 50%。Anthropic 表示将尽快恢复第三方云平台访问；该公告并未确认这一步已完成。

narrative.en: Anthropic stated on June 30 that Commerce had lifted the export-control restrictions affecting Fable 5 and Mythos 5. The administrative change was distinct from service restoration. Anthropic’s July 1 update confirmed Fable 5 first-party access, initially under phased limits; it separately described Mythos 5 access restored to a set of approved US organizations after June 26 government approval, not a general global Mythos launch. For Pro, Max, Team and select Enterprise Fable plans, up to 50% of weekly usage limits applied through July 7. AWS, Google Cloud and Microsoft Foundry access was to be re-enabled as quickly as possible; the update did not establish when that work finished. The first-party restoration was observable, but this single reversal does not prove lasting changes in general export rules, customer trust, or production migration.
narrative.zhHans: Anthropic 于 6 月 30 日表示，商务部已解除影响 Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 的出口管制。行政限制解除与服务恢复是两回事。公司于 7 月 1 日更新确认 Fable 5 在第一方服务分阶段恢复；它另行说明，Mythos 5 在政府 6 月 26 日批准后，已向一组获批美国机构恢复访问，而非面向全球普遍推出。对于 Pro、Max、Team 和指定企业 Fable 套餐，至 7 月 7 日最多占每周使用限额的 50%。AWS、Google Cloud 与 Microsoft Foundry 访问将尽快恢复；该更新未证明相关工作何时完成。第一方访问恢复是已观察到的变化，但这一次逆转不能证明普遍出口规则、客户信任或生产工作负载迁移已发生持久变化。

text.en: Anthropic said Commerce lifted the Fable 5 and Mythos 5 export controls on June 30, 2026, 18 days after the June 12 directive.
text.zhHans: Anthropic 称商务部于 2026 年 6 月 30 日解除针对 Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 的出口管制，距 6 月 12 日指令为 18 天。

text.en: A July 1 update confirmed Fable 5 access on Anthropic’s first-party services under phased limits; it separately described Mythos 5 access for a set of government-approved US organizations, without confirming completed third-party cloud restoration.
text.zhHans: Anthropic 于 7 月 1 日的更新确认 Fable 5 在第一方服务按阶段限额恢复；更新另行说明 Mythos 5 向一组经政府批准的美国机构恢复访问，但未确认第三方云平台已完成恢复。

text.en: The June 30 lifting and July 1 first-party Fable restoration do not show long-term customer trust loss, a general legal precedent, or completed third-party cloud access. Legal analysis of the earlier June 12 directive is not a review of the lifting itself.
text.zhHans: 6 月 30 日的解除限制与 7 月 1 日的 Fable 第一方访问恢复，不能证明客户信任长期受损、已确立普遍法律先例，或第三方云平台已恢复。针对 6 月 12 日早前指令的法律分析，不能当作对解禁措施本身的审查。

text.en: Anthropic’s July 1 update reports Fable 5 access restored to users of its first-party services after the June 12 suspension; it does not measure external cloud restoration or broader market effects.
text.zhHans: Anthropic 的 7 月 1 日更新称，6 月 12 日停用后 Fable 5 在第一方服务恢复用户访问；这不衡量外部云平台的恢复或更广泛的市场影响。
